_comment: THE verifier's own GitHub owners. A repository under any login listed here is `same_owner`;
every other owner is `independent`. D-12: affiliation is disclosed on the face of the record.
D-54 / AUD-001: a false `independent` on an operator-owned repository lived on the live registry
for nine days. PROVEK-QA-1023 q-1: one login was the only rule, so a repository under the
operator's organisation would have been published as `independent` -- the same defect, new instance.
WHAT COUNTS: a GitHub user or organisation the operator owns or controls. It is the verifier's
fact, not the applicant's claim, so there is no form field for it. Add an owner here, in a
one-line commit, when the operator takes control of another account; comparison is lower-cased.
Read, never defaulted: scripts/cohort.py refuses to import when this file is missing or lists
no owner. ~/orchestra/intake_cron.py cannot import cohort.py and reads this same file (T-IN-01).
